reason: The analyst's 'no effect' rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region (N=684, 1% outcome trimming, a reduced covariate set) and is reported as a single specification. My full-sample analysis with all pre-period covariates gives a positive, significant estimate of about 0.84 (SE 0.24). The analyst's subsample estimate (0.22, SE 0.41) has a CI that includes my estimate, so it is underpowered rather than evidence of no effect. I could not re-run the code to check this, so the verdict rests on comparing the two reports.
